items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: The interviewer mentions the person was 'with Johnny Hodges', but the interviewee (Cozy Cole) does not respond with any personal connection or confirmation of knowing Johnny Hodges personally.

ctx.x: In Cleveland. I've tried to contact him several times and there have been no answer. They say, I don't know, he lost his mind or he's hung up doing something, I just don't know, and I haven't bothered recently because I've tried several times and been unable to reach him, because I just figured he just didn't want to be bothered, you know. And great little trumpet player, he was with Johnny Hodges, little small band, up there he did a great job at CBS, great job.
What kind of a person was he at that time?
